mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, category_code, template_code, template_name, wf_model_id, latest_version_no, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM oa_platform_template WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM oa_platform_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND category_code = #{categoryCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM oa_platform_template WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_code = #{templateCode} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM oa_platform_template ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT t.id, t.category_code AS categoryCode, t.template_code AS templateCode, t.template_name AS templateName, t.latest_version_no AS latestVersionNo, v.id AS publishedVersionId FROM oa_platform_template t INNER JOIN oa_platform_template_version v ON v.template_id = t.id AND v.deleted = 0 AND v.version_status = 'published' WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = '0' AND t.latest_version_no > 0 ORDER BY t.category_code ASC
